comment: Vetted OSS Luau modules installable via rbx_install_module. Sources are pinned raw URLs; check each repo's license (MIT unless noted). Fetched once into vendor/cache/.

topbarplus.note: Topbar icons/buttons. Multi-file project — install pulls init.lua; follow-up: vendor the full release rbxm. [multi-file: full tree installed]

zoneplus.note: Region/zone detection (entered/exited events) for combat arenas, safe zones, checkpoints. [multi-file: full tree installed]

profileservice.note: Session-locked DataStore profiles — the standard save-system core.

trove.note: Cleanup tracker (connections/instances) — prevents leaks. [multi-file: full tree installed]

signal.note: Fast signal/event class. [multi-file: full tree installed]

testez.note: BDD unit-test runner; multi-file — vendored init only, extend manifest for full tree. [multi-file: full tree installed]

fusion.note: Declarative reactive UI/state — code-first GUI alternative to imperative GuiObjects. [multi-file: full tree installed]

cmdr.note: Admin/debug command console — embed for live ops. [multi-file: full tree installed]

knit.note: Service/controller framework scaffold (server half; pair KnitClient). [multi-file: full tree installed]

simplepath.note: Pathfinding wrapper (Path:Run + waypoints/events) — NPC crowds, pets, patrols. Single-file module.

raycasthitbox.note: Raycast melee hitboxes (Hitbox:HitStart/HitStop, OnHit events) — swords, claws, projectiles-lite. init.lua→root module, Solvers/ + deps as children. [multi-file: full tree installed]

fastcast.note: FastCastRedux (Xan_TheDragon's FastCast successor — original repo gone): high-fps projectile physics w/ length-capping, pierce, per-part hit signals. init.luau→root module. [multi-file: full tree installed]
